parallels.note: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

translations.web: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
translations.bsb: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
translations.kjv: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
translations.asv: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord saith.
